findings.constraint: this HF config uses `rope_parameters` (the newer field) but tt_transformers/tt/model_config.py:2736 only reads `rope_scaling`. The runtime will silently treat this model as having NO scaling, potentially diverging from HF reference at long contexts.
findings.fix: Mirror `rope_parameters` into `rope_scaling` in the model_params/<model>/config.json override, OR extend tt_transformers/tt/model_config.py to also read `rope_parameters`. Safe at short contexts; matters at the model's full native context.

findings.constraint: multi-core top-k requires vocab to be a power of 2 AND < 65536; else falls back to single-core
findings.fix: No action needed - kernel will use the single-core path. Decode throughput will be lower.

findings.constraint: num_key_value_heads must be divisible by TP(32); GQA/MQA shards KV across the mesh's TP dim
findings.fix: Use TP that divides 8 (e.g. 1, 2, 4, 8), or replicate KV (not supported in tt_transformers).
